hypothesis: For five fresh preregistered paired seeds, the sign of the rich-vs-sparse difference in EXPLORE occupancy during the first 30 simulated seconds prospectively predicts the direction of the later rich-vs-sparse behavioral response measured only after 30 simulated seconds.

scientific_role.e1_c_e1_d: discovery/background only; not counted as E1-E validation pairs

provenance.note: The E1-E implementation must verify that protected scientific runtime content is unchanged relative to this reference or stop before execution.

early_predictor.numeric_tolerance: none; compare the computed values directly

time_to_first_valid_food_interaction_sec.neutral: equal, including both arms censored after 30 s
time_to_first_valid_food_interaction_sec.censoring_rule: If exactly one arm has no valid food interaction after 30 s, that arm is treated as later than the arm with an observed interaction.
time_to_first_valid_food_interaction_sec.measurement: time from 30 s to first valid food interaction occurring after 30 s

selected_explore_proportion.measurement: EXPLORE occupancy proportion only during (30,180] s

food_acquisition_rate_per_sim_minute.measurement: valid food acquisitions occurring only during (30,180] s divided by 2.5 simulated minutes

pair_label_rule.predicted_metric_count: count of late primary metrics labelled predicted
pair_label_rule.opposite_metric_count: count of late primary metrics labelled opposite

prediction_scoring.neutral_policy: Any pair with a neutral early label or neutral late label makes the scientific stage classification INCONCLUSIVE when stage validity is PASS.
prediction_scoring.match_count: number of the five valid pairs with matching non-neutral early and late labels

validity.stage_pass_rule: all five declared seed pairs must be valid PASS
validity.invalid_attempt_policy: Technical invalid attempts are retained as evidence and never silently rerun, overwritten, dropped, or converted into a scientific result.

classification_order: If stage validity is not PASS: no scientific result.
If any early or late pair label is neutral: INCONCLUSIVE.
If late labels do not contain at least one predicted and at least one opposite pair: INCONCLUSIVE.
If all 5 early labels match their corresponding late labels: SUPPORTED.
If at most 3 of 5 early labels match their corresponding late labels: NOT_SUPPORTED.
If exactly 4 of 5 early labels match their corresponding late labels: INCONCLUSIVE.
hypothesis_result.supported_rule: all five pairs valid; no neutral early/late labels; both predicted and opposite late outcome classes occur; 5/5 early predictions match late labels
hypothesis_result.not_supported_rule: all five pairs valid; no neutral early/late labels; both predicted and opposite late outcome classes occur; at most 3/5 early predictions match late labels
hypothesis_result.inconclusive_rule: all five pairs valid and either exactly 4/5 predictions match, any early/late label is neutral, or only one non-neutral late outcome class occurs

anti_leakage_and_no_retuning: No E1-E late outcome may be inspected before this registration is frozen.
No predictor threshold, window, metric, seed, geometry, outcome metric, direction, or classification rule may be changed after execution begins.
The early predictor uses only [0,30] s data; every late outcome measure uses only data after 30 s.
E1-C/E1-D results are background/discovery evidence only and are not validation observations.
No production NeuralBrain, BG, policy/action-value, or learning-rule retuning is permitted within E1-E.
Fresh seeds may not be replaced after the first E1-E execution attempt.
